review.rationale: This US software engineering internship directly fits the software interest. The summary describes a full-time, in-person summer placement and continuous application review.

requirements.text: At least 18 years old and studying computing or a related STEM subject at bachelor's level or higher.
requirements.evidence: Applicants must be 18 or older, studying computing or a related STEM subject at bachelor's level or higher

requirements.text: Programming, data structures and AI-assisted development experience.
requirements.evidence: have programming, data-structure and AI-assisted development experience.

requirements.text: Expected graduation in the stated window with studies remaining after the internship.
requirements.evidence: Expected graduation: October 2027 through September 2029. Some studies must remain after the internship.

requirements.text: Available full time and in person for the 12-week summer placement.
requirements.evidence: Summer placement lasts 12 weeks, begins May/June 2027 and finishes August/September 2027. Work is in person and full time.
